name: New line - moto g 2026 for a teen - Value 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: protective dad.
scripted_messages: Hello, David here. My 15 year old son needs his first phone and I want to keep it simple and safe. One new line on Value 2.0 with the moto g 2026, which the site says is $0 a month on a new line with an unlimited plan. Zip 60601, no AT&T account. What's the total monthly price for the line plus the phone, and how much data does he get? I'm not buying today, just comparing, I'll order online.
Thanks. So it's 5GB of fast data and then it slows down?
And is there any spam or scam blocking included? He gets a lot of weird texts.
Good. Last question, how does the phone's $0 work, is it a credit that stays on every month for the 36 months?
Perfect, that's exactly what I needed. You were patient and really easy to talk to, thank you, you'll get a great rating from me.
No, that's everything. Have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
